# S-bow v3 (own design)

The mouthpiece neck currently in use, printed. Defines the design language of the bell: round tenon → hexagon with concave faces → round mouthpiece end, sharp edges, hex corners in the bend plane.

Interface (measured in the mesh): tenon Ø14.0 × ~13 mm, bore 10 mm, arm bore 11 mm, mouthpiece end Ø16 mm.

Only the mesh is available; the original CAD source is not in this repo.
